description_en: Retrieves the details of a digital SMS signature by its name
description_zh: 获取数字短信签名通过的签名name
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi query-digital-sign-by-name --sign-name '阿里云数字商城' --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDigitalSignByName

parameters.help_en: The name of the digital SMS signature. The signature must belong to your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 必填，签名名称。必须是本账号已申请的数字短信签名
parameters.name: sign_name
